title: 现在完成时的持续与具体过去时间

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

questions.prompt: The group has worked on the gallery ____ six months.
questions.evidence: The group has worked on the gallery for six months.
questions.explanation: six months 是时间长度，使用 for。

questions.prompt: Luis has worked with clay ____ four years.
questions.evidence: Luis has worked with clay for four years.
questions.explanation: four years 表示一段时间。

questions.prompt: We have used the gallery ____ Monday.
questions.evidence: We have used the gallery since Monday.

questions.prompt: The guide has ____ prepared the tour.
questions.evidence: The guide has already prepared the tour.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中的 already 放在 has 与过去分词之间。

questions.prompt: They have not finished the labels ____.
questions.evidence: They have not finished the labels yet.
questions.explanation: 否定句末用 yet 表示尚未。

questions.prompt: Has Ada finished a new portrait ____?
questions.evidence: Has Ada finished a new portrait yet?
questions.explanation: 疑问句末可用 yet 询问是否已经完成。

questions.prompt: We have ____ visited the new room.
questions.evidence: We have already visited the new room.
questions.explanation: 肯定句可用 already 表示已经参观。

questions.prompt: Ada ____ a different portrait last year.
questions.evidence: Ada finished a different portrait last year.
questions.explanation: last year 是明确已结束的过去时间，用 finished。
yesterday 指明确过去时间，用过去式 wrote。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a finished time.
options: They has opened the gallery in May last year.
They open the gallery in May last year.
They opened the gallery in May.
They have opened the gallery in May last year.
answers: They opened the gallery in May.
questions.evidence: They opened the gallery in May.
questions.explanation: 具体过去月份作已完成时间时，此例用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: She ____ the gallery before, so she knows the room.
questions.evidence: She has visited the gallery before, so she knows the room.
questions.explanation: 未给具体过去时间，过去经历与现在认识房间有关，使用 has visited。

instructions: Read the Chinese explanations, then answer the questions.
passage:
1. 现在完成时 have / has + 过去分词，可描述从过去持续到现在的状态。for 后接时间长度，如 for six months；since 后接起点，如 since Monday。
例句：The group has worked on the gallery for six months. Ada has lived here since 2023. Luis has worked with clay for four years. We have used the gallery since Monday.

2. already 常用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 常用于否定句或疑问句句末，表示“尚未／已经了吗”。have / has 与主语一致。
例句：The guide has already prepared the tour. They have not finished the labels yet. Has Ada finished a new portrait yet? We have already visited the new room.

3. 明确的已结束过去时间通常用一般过去时，如 last year；不要与 have + 过去分词连用。现在完成时关注与现在有关的经历或结果，不必须给出具体过去时间。
例句：Ada finished a different portrait last year. Luis wrote the note yesterday. They opened the gallery in May. She has visited the gallery before, so she knows the room.
